## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A four-fascicle composite work combining Dàoxuān's parent commentary on the *Hánzhù jièběn* ([KR6k0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0131)) with **Yuánzhào's** 元照 ([元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7)) sub-commentary. The Japanese monk **Sokujō** [即靜](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8D%B3%E9%9D%9C) added analytical divisions (分會 *fēnhuì*) for instructional use.

**Abstract**

The composite Tang-Sòng-Japanese transmission of this text reflects the international scope of late-medieval East Asian Vinaya scholarship: the Tang commentary tradition (Dàoxuān) was extended in the Sòng (Yuánzhào) and further refined for Japanese instructional use. The text became a standard Japanese Risshū reference.
